python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.lighting import get_lighting_patterns
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Pattern(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_lighting_pattern"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",      "string", widget_type="text", default="list")
        self.add_input("pattern_id",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("environment", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("mood",        "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("query",       "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("scene_json",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]
        self.add_output("result_json",  "string")
        self.add_output("pattern_name", "string")

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action      = str(inputs.get("action",      "list") or "list").lower().strip()
        pattern_id  = str(inputs.get("pattern_id",  "") or "")
        environment = str(inputs.get("environment", "") or "")
        mood        = str(inputs.get("mood",        "") or "")
        query       = str(inputs.get("query",       "") or "")
        scene_json  = str(inputs.get("scene_json",  "") or "")
        try:
            scene_dict = json.loads(scene_json) if scene_json.strip() else {}
        except Exception:
            scene_dict = {}
        try:
            lib = get_lighting_patterns()
            if action == "get":
                p = lib.get_pattern(pattern_id)
                result = p.to_dict() if p else {}
                name = p.name if p else ""
            elif action == "search":
                results = lib.search_patterns(query=query, environment=environment, mood=mood)
                result = [p.to_dict() for p in results]
                name = results[0].name if results else ""
            elif action == "rank":
                results = lib.rank_patterns(scene_dict)
                result = [p.to_dict() for p in results]
                name = results[0].name if results else ""
            elif action == "recommend":
                p = lib.recommend_pattern(environment=environment, mood=mood)
                result = p.to_dict() if p else {}
                name = p.name if p else ""
            else:  # list
                results = lib.search_patterns()
                result = [p.to_dict() for p in results]
                name = ""
            self.log_info(f"Lighting pattern action={action}: {len(result) if isinstance(result, list) else 1} result(s).")
            return {
                "result_json":  json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "pattern_name": name,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Lighting pattern action failed: {exc}")
            return {"result_json": "{}", "pattern_name": "", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Pattern
